global_rules.rule: Publikasi sosial resmi dikawal penuh oleh Agent QC (Invariant Auditor). Draf yang lolos audit (skor >= 80, 0 defect) otomatis terbit; draf dengan skor < 80 atau memiliki cacat visual/fakta otomatis ditolak mutlak.
Production UI/source/design assets must not use Unicode emoji; use SVG/vector or plain text indicators.
If Mas Bagas scores output below 5, do not cosmetic-patch; reset from upstream reference/design/copy research.
Public HTML must not contain localhost/127.0.0.1 URLs.

social_rules.rule: SputarBall hero images must not use generic green pitch, 3D cartoon stadium, empty turf, or repeated template fallback.
SputarBall must use authentic HD match/action/player/kit photos with no watermark and no wrong-subject image.
Block sensational clickbait and unverified claims; no official evidence means no publication.
Sputarai carousel must be exactly 4 slides: headline, facts/analysis, facts/analysis, CTA.
